Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars: the de-risk theme ran ~15 (7/09->7/29); the risk-on reversal is now 5 completed bars (7/29, 7/30, 7/31, 8/3, 8/4) with the 8/4 close now counted; the breadth-broadening above 60% is just 1 completed bar (the 8/4 close at 62.16%, the first above threshold), so the breakout is confirmed but the broad-participation leg is one bar young. Catalysts, nearest-first: whether the 8/4 breakout FOLLOWS THROUGH on 8/5 (SPY holding at/above the new high with breadth holding above 60% and dealers positive-gamma above the 758.41 flip, versus a pin/fade back toward the 758.41 flip under the 775 call wall), the direction of conditional vol (elevated now), the official 7/29 FOMC statement/path (still unverified — re-pull), then July NFP 8/7 8:30am ET and the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
